Plompy 0.8.1

Safe goal recovery under queue pressure

This is a historical release. Its notes describe this version, not the current setup. See the latest stable release before starting a new installation.

This version predates Plompy Local. It covers the Discord engine; the separate local MCP gateway and starter kit arrive in 0.13.0.

GitHub notes and assets for this version may use the earlier Szpont name. Historical filenames and source links are preserved.

What changed#

  • Keep the shared 30-job queue bound when resuming a safely paused supervised goal. A full queue leaves its saved candidate, control state and remaining budget unchanged; retry !goal resume after capacity is available.
  • Point unsuccessful goal controls to !queue as well as !goal status. Existing per-thread limits, supervision, providers and SQLite schema 6 are unchanged.

Downloads and source#

This GitHub release has no separately uploaded download assets. Its source and published distribution details are linked from the release page.

Original GitHub release · Source at v0.8.1 · Changelog at this tag

Before you upgrade#

Back up private state and credentials, review the version's migration boundaries, and retain a compatible rollback snapshot. A release does not update an existing deployment automatically.
